meaning:
ἀλλόφυλος, -ον
(ἄλλος, φῦλον, a tribe), [in LXX chiefly for פְּלֶשֶׁת ;]
foreign, of another race (MM, VGT, see word); as opposite to a Jew, a Gentile: Act.10:28.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me…
